UWSGI_PORT.description: The port on which the Vitrage collector UWSGI service listens.

UWSGI_INI_PATH.description: Path to the UWSGI configuration file.

UWSGI_INI_APP.description: Path to the UWSGI application ini file, used for existence checks.

UWSGI_BIND_CONFIG_FILE.description: Path to an optional INI file to bind configuration from. If empty, UWSGI_BIND_IP is empty.

UWSGI_BIND_CONFIG_SECTION.description: Section name in the bind config file.

UWSGI_BIND_CONFIG_IP_DIRECTIVE.description: Directive key for IP address in the bind config file.

UWSGI_BIND_CONFIG_PORT_DIRECTIVE.description: Directive key for port in the bind config file.

UWSGI_BIND_CONFIG_WORKERS_DIRECTIVE.description: Directive key for workers count in the bind config file.
